quests.title: Alto Mare Waters → islands → back: the Manaphy Egg

acquisitions.conditions: Tell the Egg girl in Alto Mare Waters to walk with it, then follow and speak to her in order on Six Island, Five Island and Four Island. Return to western Alto Mare Waters, defeat the two treasure hunters, and accept the hatched Manaphy with a free party slot.
